newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits high of $22 shortly before close.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits high of $22 shortly before close.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures hit a high for the day on Monday of $22 a barrel after the U.N. put oil sales by Iraq on ice after Baghdad sent troops into its Kurdish territories.
October Brent was trading up $1.21 a barrel shortly before the close at $21.99 and September gas oil was at five-year highs, up $10.75 a tonne at $207.50 a tonne.
Dealers said Brent and gas oil saw some fresh buying just ahead of the end of a session truncated because of the U.S. Labor Day holiday.
Gas oil kept pace with Brent's gains, keeping the crack spread premium at a healthy $5.38 for October contracts.
Low heating oil and diesel stocks in Europe and the U.S. have kept distillate prices at the leading edge of higher oil prices over the past month.
